author: Delacroid
body:
Hello guys, I just wanted to introduce myself.

I have been playing this game since 1.2.5 and I am a former OCN player.
Since the shutdown of overcast I´m playing this server, Stratus and the japanese one so glad to know this community and I expect to be more involved in it
